newsitem.title: USA: Biogen off on weekly prescription data.
newsitem.headline: Biogen off on weekly prescription data.

text.p: Shares of Biogen Inc fell 2-1/4 to 38-1/4 on Monday after the release of unfavorable weekly company prescription data, traders said.
"The weekly prescription numbers came out and were disappointing" said one trader. "But all the biotechs are off today."
Amgen Inc was down 7/8 to 56-1/2, and Chiron Corp was off 3/8 to 18-7/8.
The weekly prescription data, compiled by IMS America and released today, showed that prescriptions for Biogen's AVONEX, which treats multiple sclerosis, dropped five percent for the past week.
The data also showed that prescriptions for Schering AG's competing Betaseron rose 11 percent.
However, an analyst said he believed the figures were skewed.
"One week's data in isolation does not look good, but we have to remember that the data is (distorted) by the holiday effect," said David Stone, an analyst with Cowen & Co.
Stone said that during the holidays some people don't take their medications as diligently as usual, and doctor visits, which are related to the filling of prescriptions, drop.
He also said he prefers to look at longer periods than one week.
"Betaseron was down significantly over the Thanksgiving week...and this drop caused a bigger bounce," Stone said.
